decisions.reason: It has only been mentioned on the website with no dedicated page, indicating little investment and limited public commitment, so escalation-of-commitment logic makes dropping likely.
Like Product A, it lacks a dedicated page and visible commitment, and after two years its results can no longer be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm is likely to drop it.
It has its own page and several models, signaling substantial investment and public commitment, so management will persist with it despite any disappointments.
The online platform aligns with the firm's announced service and digital direction and has a dedicated page, making it central and visible, so it is likely to be kept.
Its promotion from a mere mention to its own page shows increasing public commitment and investment, making a drop less likely under escalation of commitment.
